map.tagline.muenster: A hunt through the city of bicycles
map.tagline.luebeck: Escape across the bridges of the old-town island
mission.case.muenster.diebstahlserie-alt: A break-in spree in the old town

Three nights, three break-ins around Domplatz and Prinzipalmarkt — now the gang is hitting the palace. An informant in Wienburgpark wants the escape route, but he demands a favour: the municipal works at the harbour are to be shut down. Then out via the harbour pier before the detectives close the net.
mission.case.muenster.kurier-am-hafen.st: A courier walked off with the wrong files in the warehouse district. The depot must be emptied before the contents change hands. The contact is a boatman in the palace park — he offers to cripple the town hall so the manhunt runs dry. Or get straight out to Wolbeck.
